cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: The Logic Gets Bigger
cards.instruction: Use every new detail to expand the impossible system, its history, and the consequences of breaking it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Our meeting chairs float at noon. Book the ceiling; they've had landing rights since the first furniture strike.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we stand and tie the chairs down?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Restraint broke the last treaty. That's when the desks joined them. We'll need an airspace permit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The caretaker only issues floor permits.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then promote her to altitude minister before the cabinets claim the roof.
